title: REQ · Blank-text tests assert inline message and no submit call
summary: Blank and whitespace-only submit tests assert the real inline message and zero API calls
description: Context: handleSubmit sets validation 'Enter an idea first' and returns before submitContribution. Desired behavior: tests assert the alert text, aria-invalid, aria-describedby and zero submit calls. Expected result: removing the blank guard fails these tests. Why: proves blank text cannot be submitted.
acceptance_criteria: Given empty or whitespace text, when Send is clicked, then role=alert text equals 'Enter an idea first' and submitContribution has 0 calls
Given the message is shown, when the user types, then the alert disappears and aria-invalid is no longer true
technical_constraints: Component source must not be mocked
definition_of_done: Blank tests pass and fail without the blank guard
